title: Chess Level / Puzzle
description: Format for a single puzzle level. This schema only checks the shape of the file (right fields, right types). It cannot tell you whether startingFen is a legal position or whether solution is a legal sequence of moves — for that, run validate-levels.js, which replays the position through the actual chess engine.

id.description: Unique level identifier, e.g. "level_1". Should match the filename by convention.

description.description: Optional flavor text or instructions shown to the player before they attempt the level.

hint.description: Optional hint shown if the player asks for one.

startingFen.description: FEN of the puzzle's starting position. The side to move is taken from this FEN, not stated separately, so there is only one place that can go stale.

solution.description: The moves that solve the puzzle, in order, alternating sides starting from whichever side startingFen says is to move.

promotion.description: Set only when this step is a pawn promotion.
